item.title: European Investment Bank Backs Minesto
item.description: Minesto, leading ocean energy developer, has, on a complementary basis, been selected for in-depth investment advisory support by the European Investment Bank (EIB) under the PDA (Project Development Assistance) program. item.title: SeaRush Takes Step Towards Scalable 3D-Printed USVs
item.description: In December, MARIN conducted the first on-water tests with a prototype of the SeaRush uncrewed surface vessel (USV) in the Rijnhaven in Wageningen. Within five months, the design evolved into a floating test platform for uncrewed maritime systems.

item.title: FET Agrees Milestone Deal to Supply European Navy with ROV
item.description: Forum Energy Technologies (FET) has secured a contract with a major shipbuilding group to supply a European navy with a state-of-the-art remotely operated vehicle (ROV). The Super Mohawk system was selected due to its small footprint and high payload, allowing the system to be fitted with all the advanced equipment required.

item.title: Breaking Boundaries in Subsea Imaging
item.description: Impact Subsea, a leader in innovative subsea sensor technology, has highlighted the continuous development and global success of the ISS360 Imaging Sonar range.

item.title: Saab Seaeye Lynx Plays Critical Role in Holy Grail San José Shipwreck Survey
item.description: Saab UK’s Seaeye Lynx subsea vehicle played a critical role in the survey and documentation of the 18th-century galleon San José, a Colombian cultural heritage asset.

item.title: Hefring Marine’s IMAS is Now Available on Raymarine’s LightHouse OS
item.description: Hefring Marine, a leader in marine artificial intelligence solutions, today announced that its Intelligent Marine Assistance System (IMAS) is now available as an approved integration on Raymarine's LightHouse operating system. This collaboration enables Raymarine Axiom display users to access IMAS's advanced AI-powered digital assistant directly from their helm, delivering real-time guidance for safer, more efficient voyages.

item.title: In-Place Pile Repair for Demanding Marine Environments
item.description: Denso, Inc., a global leader in corrosion prevention and sealing technologies, has highlighted the SeaShield Series FX-70® pile repair and protection system, a cost-effective, long-term solution engineered to restore and protect damaged steel, concrete, and timber piles in harsh marine and waterfront environments. item.title: New TrustLink Coax Connector Engineered for High-Integrity Connectivity Solutions
item.description: High-integrity signal transmission is mission-critical in subsea operations, whether for HD video, radar, or telemetry. MacArtney’s new TrustLink™ Coax connector delivers this capability through precision impedance matching in a compact, rugged design that ensures stable, low-loss connections for demanding environments.

item.title: EnerMech Appoints LNG Expert to Lead Its Global Infrastructure and Industrial Solutions Team
item.description: EnerMech has appointed LNG industry leader Vasant Saith as Senior Vice President of its Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions (I&I) global business line, strengthening the company’s leadership team as it accelerates growth in North America and beyond.

item.title: MARSS Successfully Completes ISO 21195 Phase 3 Testing for MOBtronic Man-Overboard Detection System
item.description: MARSS has successfully completed Phase 3 testing of the ISO 21195 standard for man-overboard (MOB) detection systems—a rigorous, internationally recognized benchmark, designed to verify real-world performance and reliability on operating vessels. This milestone further establishes MARSS’ MOBtronic solution as the leading system proven to meet ISO requirements through real-world on-ship testing.
